title: Steven Galbraith – Five Tool Player (Capital Allocators, EP.01)
summary:
This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. So one of my early pieces was on the serial industry and how the
pricing structure had to collapse because of the margin structure had run up too high. And if anything, it was, again, with
the benefit of hindsight, it was a sign of risk tolerance coming back to the market.
